geo_headlines: TWO US TROOPS KILLED IN JORDAN by Iranian ballistic missile + drone attack — first US military fatalities since renewed hostilities. One missing, four wounded and hospitalized (CENTCOM)
US launches 8th consecutive night of strikes on Iran (Sun 7/19 completed 11:30pm ET Sat), targeting IRGC directly for first time. Strikes on Sirik, Hajiabad, Qeshm Island near Strait of Hormuz
Iran retaliates: kamikaze drones strike TWO US bases in Kuwait — Camp Udairi ammo depot + Ali Al Salem AB Patriot radar. Kuwait Petroleum Corp site + power/desalination plants also hit
US-Iran preliminary deal COLLAPSED; Iran suspends Islamabad MoU (Deputy FM Gharibabadi); 50,000 US troops on alert regionally (Ynetnews)
IRGC claims second wave of Hormuz mine explosions Sunday morning; Strait of Hormuz operating at 11% of pre-crisis volume (10 vessels vs 88/day baseline per PortWatch)
Oil settled Fri: WTI $82.49 (+16% wk), Brent $88.10; US gasoline set to top $4/gallon nationwide (up 11c in past week per CBS)
FOMC blackout period active (7/18-7/30). No Fed speakers until 7/29 decision
headline: Iran conflict enters kinetic escalation phase: US troops killed in Jordan, 8th night of US strikes on Iran, Iran hits US bases in Kuwait, preliminary deal collapsed. Sunday 6pm ET futures reopen into war-premium gap.
client_frame: The weekend materially changed the risk picture. Two US troops killed in Jordan Friday overnight made this a shooting conflict with confirmed US casualties, not a proxy exchange. Trump has ordered 8 consecutive nights of strikes on Iran, now directly targeting the IRGC. Iran has retaliated against US bases in Kuwait with drones, hit Kuwaiti civilian energy infrastructure, and suspended the Islamabad MoU. The preliminary US-Iran deal is collapsed. Fifty thousand US troops are on regional alert. Hormuz shipping is at 11% of pre-crisis volume. WTI closed Fri at $82.49, up 16% on the week; Brent $88.10. US gasoline is on its way through $4/gallon. Sunday 6pm ET futures reopen carries meaningful gap-down risk on equities and gap-up on oil, gold, and defense. VIX at 18.77 remains below panic but the tape is priced for realized vol, not tail risk. Client framing: this is now an oil-supply-shock plus geopolitical-risk-premium regime laid on top of an AI/semi de-rating. Growth-tech and semis remain under pressure. Energy, defense, gold, front-end Treasuries doing their job. Stay disciplined, avoid headline chasing, remember base rates. The next Fed touchpoint is 7/29 Powell; blackout is on. If clients call worried, reframe: SPX drawdowns of 5-10% happen roughly three times a year. What matters more than direction is leadership rotation — and rotation is happening in real time.
